mentions.name: stk
mentions.description: Async Quart + Vue 3 starter kit with a pre-wired auth stack (session, 2FA, WebAuthn, OAuth), async SQLAlchemy, Alembic migrations, and no frontend build step, so the boilerplate is done and building the actual product can start faster.
mentions.problem: Rebuilding the boring boilerplate (auth, database setup, frontend builds) for every new web project slows down getting to the actual product.
mentions.source_excerpt: stk (https://github.com/level09/stk):  async Quart + Vue 3 starter i use for everything. auth stack is already wired up (session, 2FA, webauthn, oauth), async sqlalchemy, alembic, no frontend build step. basically the boring part so i can get to the actual product faster.
